offering_description.value: Operates venues for concerts, professional sports, comedy and stage shows, serving audiences, promoters and sports teams. It also produces live shows and sells tickets, premium hospitality, concessions and sponsorships.

primary_services.value: live event hosting; theatrical show production; venue licensing; premium hospitality; sponsorship and advertising

customer_segment.value: B2C: concertgoers, sports fans and theater audiences; B2B: event promoters, professional sports teams, sponsors and corporate hospitality buyers

end_markets.value: live music; professional sports; theater; comedy; family entertainment

revenue_model.value: service fees: admission to live events and premium hospitality packages; rental or leasing: arena use by professional teams, venue rentals and suite licenses; advertising: venue sponsorships, signage and brand promotions; product sales: food, beverages and event merchandise sold at venues
revenue_model.category: service fees; rental or leasing; advertising; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates arenas and theaters, providing event space to promoters and sports teams; service provider: works with performers and production crews to stage shows for ticket buyers; retailer: sells concessions and event merchandise to venue visitors

geography_served.value: US regional: New York City and Chicago

specialization.value: related lines: arena and theater operations, live show production, premium hospitality and venue sponsorships

distribution_channels.value: online: event websites and online ticketing platforms; own locations: venue box offices, concession stands and merchandise counters; direct sales: venue bookings, suite sales and sponsorship agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: venues subject to local building, fire and occupancy codes and state liquor licensing
